blocks.title: Operator precedence
blocks.text: Operator precedence tay karti hai ke expression mein amal kis tarteeb se honge. Python mein, riyazi ki tarah, kuch operators ki tarjeeh zyada hoti hai aur woh pehle hote hain.

items: Jama + aur tafreeq -: sab se kam; 5 + 2 = 7, 10 - 4 = 6.

blocks.text: Maslan 3 + 2 * 5 mein zarb pehle hoti hai: 3 + 10 = 13. Qausain istemal karne se pecheeda expressions wazeh hote aur amal irade ki tarteeb mein hote hain (Did You Know).

blocks.alt: Chaar khaanon ki seerhi: sab se oopar qausain ( ), phir power **, phir zarb, taqseem aur modulus * / %, aur sab se neeche jama aur tafreeq + -. Baen taraf teer 'pehle' se 'baad mein' ki taraf. Neeche misalein: 3 + 2 * 5 -> 3 + 10 -> 13 aur (3 + 2) * 4 -> 5 * 4 -> 20.
blocks.caption: Operator precedence ki seerhi: jo oopar hai woh pehle hota hai (asal khaaka; kitab mein figure nahi).

blocks.prompt: Operator precedence ki tareef kijiye aur aisi misal dijiye jahan yeh nateeja badle (short question 3).
blocks.explanation: Yeh qaida hai ke kaunsa amal pehle hoga. 2 + 3 * 4 ka jawab 14 hai kyunke * + se pehle hota hai, jabke (2 + 3) * 4 ka 20.

blocks.prompt: Long question 1: paanch expressions nikalein, maslan (b) (25 + 3 * 4 ** 2 - 6) / (2 ** 3 + 1) - 7 aur (d) 45 / (2 ** 2 + 3 * 4) + 8 * (7 - 3).

items: Precedence: pehle (), phir **, phir * / // %, phir + -; 3 + 2 * 5 = 13; qausain irada wazeh karti hain.
